Nightly builds wait on the cache, not on the compiler

62%

of a nightly build is spent restoring and re-uploading the dependency cache. Compiling takes 9 minutes of the 38. Keep the cache per branch and the build drops to about 15 minutes.

What the research recommends

Keep the dependency cache per branch

Worked case: a nightly build on main restores 1.2 GB instead of 4.8 GB, and ends near 15 minutes.

Evidence: report § Recommendations →
Defer a remote build cache

Worked case: it helps the new-dependency build most, which happens about twice a month.
